questions.questionText:
A word and number arrangement machine when given an input line rearranges them step by step following a specific rule:
Input: table 48 12 chair 79 apple 25 zebra
In Step I, the smallest number (12) moves to the first position from left.
What will be Step I for this input?
questions.hint: Decode the pattern: Numbers sort ascending from left, words sort descending from right.
questions.explanation: The machine logic in Step 1 extracts the lowest integer (12) and shifts it to the extreme left position, shifting other elements sequentially.
solutionSteps: Step 1: Compare input with subsequent steps to identify sorting criteria.
Step 2: Note the positioning rule (left end vs right end).
Step 3: Execute step transitions sequentially.
Step 4: Output is 12 table 48 chair 79 apple 25 zebra.
questions.memoryTip: Number sorting = Ascending/Descending; Word sorting = Alphabetical / Length of word. Identify the anchor side first!
